recipe.visualDefinition: A high-energy, vibrant composition featuring a group of diverse teenagers jumping joyfully out of a bright blue swimming pool, set against a backdrop of rippling water with large, textured 3D typography dominating the upper half.
coreVisualRelationships: Dynamic upward movement of figures contrasting with the horizontal water surface
Massive scale of typography relative to the human subjects
Vibrant primary and secondary clothing colors popping against a monochromatic blue background
Sparkling gold and glitter textures creating a sense of glamour and celebration
coreInvariants: Caustic light patterns on blue water
Water splashes at the base of the jumping figures
Beveled 3D text with internal glitter textures

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Six teenagers arranged in a horizontal line across the lower third, scaled to appear smaller than the main title.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, three-tiered golden title block centered in the upper two-thirds.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large numeral on the right, moves left across the title, then drops down to the expressive faces of the jumping group.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The blue water background provides consistent negative space around the central elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cerulean blue water background providing cool tones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm gold and yellow in the typography and clothing.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Sparkling light blue glitter on the large numeral and white water splashes.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across all elements with high-key lighting to eliminate deep shadows.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid dark, muddy, or desaturated tones

letterConstructionRules: Deep 3D beveling with a gold metallic edge
Internal fill featuring a granular, sparkling gold texture
Tight vertical leading between stacked lines
characterSpecificRedesigns: Large numeral featuring a distinct blue glitter texture and white outer glow
Small lens flare 'sparkles' placed on sharp corners of letters
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single heavy display face with varying textures and one script-based brand mark at the top.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and geometric clarity for the 3D treatment.
Offers a classic bold American aesthetic suitable for teen media.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A vibrant overhead view of a swimming pool with clear blue water, sun-dappled caustic patterns, and six diverse teenagers in colorful summer clothes jumping mid-air with splashes at their feet.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three lines of large, centered, stacked uppercase text in a heavy 3D gold glitter style. Add a large blue glitter numeral to the right of the stack. Place a small script logo at the very top center.

verificationChecks: Is the water texture visible through the gaps in the group?
Does the text have a convincing 3D beveled edge?
Are there white water splashes at the point of impact for each person?

adjustableVariables: Number of people in the jumping group
Color of the glitter texture in the text

mustAchieve: Crisp, sharp focus on both text and subjects
avoid: Motion blur on the jumping figures

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is perfectly centered horizontally.
Check that the 3D extrusion direction is consistent across all letters.
Verify that the water splashes look integrated with the subjects' feet.
Confirm the blue glitter on the numeral contrasts sufficiently with the blue water.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-action group shot in a bright summer environment with massive, beveled, textured display typography that occupies the top half of the frame.
